ASPACE COMPANY SRL develops high-value software that integrates advanced proprietary ensemble machine learning models with remote sensing (multispectral and hyperspectral) data from Earth observation satellites, such as Sentinel, to develop an innovative software product that provides predictive soil information. By combining soil sample data with multispectral satellite imagery, the resulting high-value technology generates precise, high-resolution soil profiles to optimise agricultural decisions like soil fertility, nutrient management, and fertiliser requirements.
Multispectral and hyperspectral satellite image captures critical data across multiple electromagnetic wavelengths, enabling a detailed analysis of soil properties. The proprietary ensemble machine learning framework, a cornerstone of this innovative technology, combines algorithms in a generalised model to ensure superior accuracy and scalability.
This high-value innovation addresses traditional challenges in soil analysis by introducing a scalable and quantitative approach using Earth observation data. It not only enhances fertiliser recommendations but also mitigates global supply issues affected by geopolitical tensions, offering a high-value solution for precision agriculture.
With this innovative product, farmers no longer need hardware or physical soil sampling. Using only GPS coordinates, the system delivers fast, affordable, and accurate soil analysis, paired with tailored fertiliser recommendations and digital management tools. By leveraging artificial intelligence and satellite data, this high-value innovation operates on a continental or global scale, empowering agricultural productivity through cutting-edge solutions.

entityDescription:
Foundation Space Resources (FSR) is a for-profit company specializing in advanced modelling and simulation technologies for the space industry. Established on October 14, 2020, in Alberta, Canada, FSR has rapidly positioned itself as a leader in Lunar mission planning, environmental simulation, and system modelling, catering to space agencies, research institutions, and private aerospace firms.
With a lean but highly specialized team, FSR has successfully developed innovative Digital Twin technology to address critical gaps in Lunar exploration. The company has actively engaged in industry partnerships and secured interest from key stakeholders and customers such as Canadensys, Starpath Robotics (Starpath), Space Copy, Orbit Share, and the North American Space Institute (NASI).

FSR's Lunar Digital Twin is the only commercially available tool which can provide high temporal and spatial fidelity illumination maps of the entire Lunar surface, including the 3-dimensional structure of shadows above the surface. Customers are currently using it to quantify (and thereby optimize) hardware design constraints and develop flexible mission plans. Currently TRL 4, it simulates the components of and the interactions between the different aspects of the cislunar (i.e. between the Earth and the Moon) environment. FSR's near-term goal is to develop our Lunar Digital Twin into a flexible tool for Lunar hardware design constraint and mission planning optimization. Our long-term vision is to develop our Digital Twin into a comprehensive dynamic simulation of the Lunar environment, capable of supporting automated virtual testing, economic assessments, demand analysis for Lunar services, and mission planning as well as be deployed on Lunar assets to aid in navigation. FSR is enhancing this tool with recent advances in AI, including explainability and evolutionary algorithms to optimize hardware design, mission planning, and decision-making processes.

FSR aims to meet the growing demand for high-fidelity Lunar modelling and simulation capabilities arising from the developing awareness of the commercial Lunar industry that current design and testing methodologies do not sufficiently de-risk hardware designs and mission plans to meet desired mission timelines and profitability. High-fidelity Lunar modelling and simulation capabilities are not only critical for mission planning and system design but are also vital for the verification, validation, and stress testing of space systems.

entityDescription:
Skyline Drones SRL has stood out since 2019 in the Romanian UAV market as a leading provider of customized services for 3D scanning and aerial inspection through drones across various industries such as precision agriculture, telecommunications, electrical networks, wind farms and photovoltaic parks, construction (civil and industrial), utility infrastructure (water and sewage), as well as the oil and gas industry (refineries, pipelines, oil tanks), environmental monitoring, surveillance and safety. 
Starting in 2021, the company began the commercialization of professional drones, offering end customers training in drone usage, as well as support for drone registration and authorization acquisition. Over the years, the portfolio has been enhanced with the use and/or commercialization of new drones and technologies, following certifications from UAV and related system manufacturers such as Quantum Systems, Micasense, YellowScan, Pix4D, UgCS, Accecore Technologies, Sitemark, Emlid, DJI, Deltaquad, Hexadrone, Diodon, PhaseOne, Sentera, Sniffer, Agremo, Agisoft, Elistair, CHC Nav. In 2022, Skyline Drones launched the Skyline Academy. 
In 2024, implementation of the research and development project “AI Drones for Sustainable Wheat Farming” (AgriDrone) in collaboration with partner Agrivi from Croatia, funded through Eurostars 2023, aimed at the development and commercialization of a farm management software platform based on artificial intelligence and high-resolution imagery provided by drones (https://skylinedrones.ro/ai-drones-for-sustainable-wheat-farming/).
The 7 teams offer nationwide and regional coverage in Eastern Europe, with completed projects in Hungary, Bulgaria, Serbia, and Kosovo. Certified pilots can proudly claim the scanning of 400 MWh of photovoltaic parks, over 100,000 hectares of agricultural crops, and approximately 100 industrial facilities/buildings inspected in various regions of Romania, as well as in Eastern European countries, totaling around 150 customized projects tailored to client needs that demonstrate the high added value of Skyline Drones SRL’s innovative aerial inspection services in multiple key economic sectors at the national level.
